$comment: Scriptwell static-analysis rules. ONE file, used by the GitHub Actions analyzer (Node) and by the in-app import check (JavaScriptCore). Edit here, then run scripts/sync-analyzer.sh to copy into gallery-template/.

network.title: Network
network.summary: Send and receive data over HTTPS with fetch().
network.detail: The script can contact any HTTPS server and send it any data the script has access to.

location.title: Location
location.detail: The script can read your approximate or precise location while it runs. iOS will also ask you separately.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.detail: The script can read event titles, times, locations and notes. iOS will also ask you separately.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.detail: The script can read your reminders, add new ones and mark them complete. iOS will also ask you separately.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.detail: The script can schedule and cancel local notifications from Scriptwell. iOS will also ask you separately.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.detail: The script can read whatever you last copied and can replace it.

rules.message: eval() is not allowed. Scripts must not build code from strings.
Indirect eval, such as (0, eval)(...), is not allowed.
new Function(...) is not allowed. Scripts must not build code from strings.
Function(...) is not allowed. Scripts must not build code from strings.
Reaching the Function constructor through .constructor.constructor is not allowed.
Computed access to ["constructor"] is not allowed.
Dynamic import() is not allowed. Scripts are single files.
setTimeout with a string argument is not allowed. Pass a function.
setInterval with a string argument is not allowed. Pass a function.
Computed access on globalThis hides which APIs a script uses. Call APIs by name.
Computed access on window hides which APIs a script uses. Call APIs by name.
Computed access on self hides which APIs a script uses. Call APIs by name.
Identifiers starting with __sw or __native are reserved for the Scriptwell runtime.
Identifiers written with \u escapes ({value} found) hide what the code calls.
{value} identifiers look machine-obfuscated (for example _0x1a2b). Submit readable source.
The script is {value} bytes; the limit is 200000.
A string literal is {value} characters long. Large embedded payloads are not allowed.
A string literal is {value} characters long. Reviewers will check what it contains.
A {value}-character literal looks like base64 or hex data. Reviewers will check what it contains.
String literals are mostly hex/unicode escapes ({value} escapes). Submit readable source.
{value} hex/unicode escapes in string literals. Reviewers will check why.
A line of code is {value} characters long. Minified code is not allowed.
Lines average {value} characters. The code may be minified.

textFilter.$comment: Applied to name and description. Case-insensitive whole-word match after simple leetspeak folding. Deliberately short; maintainers extend it in the gallery repo.
